ai_language_tip: Always speak polite French (fr); Monaco (mc) businesses also speak French by default and English widely; in France switch to English only if staff offers.
english_ok: sometimes — Common in Monaco, Paris tourist districts, and Riviera hotels, but local clinics, artisans, and offices expect French.
politeness: ALWAYS open with 'Bonjour Madame / Monsieur' before any request, use strict 'vous', soften with conditional ('je souhaiterais'), close with 'Merci, bonne journée, au revoir'.
name_tip: Title + surname (Monsieur/Madame Dupont) is standard; spell surnames carefully with French first names ('D comme Denis, U comme Ursule').
phone_tip: France 10 digits (06 12 34 56 78 or 07..., Paris 01 23 45 67 89) read in two-digit pairs; Monaco 8 digits (99 12 34 56); SMS confirmation common.
time_tip: 24-hour standard ('19h30' / 'dix-neuf heures trente'); lunch 12:00–14:00, dinner 19:30–21:30 (most non-brasserie kitchens close between!).
number_tip: Watch vigesimal numbers: soixante (60) vs soixante-dix (70) and quatre-vingts (80) vs quatre-vingt-dix (90); repeat pairs slowly.
avoid_calling: Avoid restaurant coup de feu 12:15–14:00 and 19:30–21:15, shop lunch break 12:30–14:00 in provinces, and calls after 20:00.
closed_days: Many restaurants/bistros close Sunday–Monday; salons close Sundays and Mondays; shops close Sundays; heavy August closures (fermeture annuelle en août).
booking_channels: Doctolib dominates medical/dental completely; Planity and Treatwell for hair/beauty; TheFork and Zenchef for restaurants.
voice_menu: Medical tele-secretariats, hospitals, administrations (CAF/CPAM/Impôts), banks, telecoms, SNCF, and couriers use heavy keypad IVR.
callback_habits: Zenchef/TheFork and Planity/Doctolib send automated SMS confirmations; fine dining requires clicking 'Confirmer ma présence' 24h ahead.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 法國餐廳多僅午晚兩段供餐（12:00–14:00、19:30後），熱門店常發 Zenchef 簡訊要求刷卡留印。
usually_asked: Date and service: lunch (midi) or dinner (soir, usually 19:30+)
Indoor dining room (en salle) vs terrace (en terrasse — often unbookable)
Surname (au nom de M./Mme...) and 06/07 mobile number

may_come_up.what: Sends Zenchef/SevenRooms SMS link for card pre-authorization (empreinte bancaire)
Terrace tables are first-come first-served only
Two dinner seatings (premier service 19:30 vs deuxième service 21:30)

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card digits over phone

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 法國診所與牙醫高度依賴 Doctolib，許多醫師不收新病患且電話轉接外包秘書台（含按鍵選單）並必問生日。
usually_asked: Already followed by this practitioner vs new patient (déjà patient du cabinet ou nouveau patient)
Reason for consultation (motif de consultation / urgence dentaire)
Patient surname, first name, and maiden name if applicable

may_come_up.what: Doctor refuses new patients ('ne prend plus de nouveaux patients') or books on Doctolib only
Medical tele-secretariat starts with keypad IVR ('tapez 1')
Sector 2 fee overrun (dépassement d'honoraires / secteur 2) mentioned

sensitive_asked.what: Asks date of birth (date de naissance) or Carte Vitale / Sécurité sociale number

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 許多髮廊與美容院已全面導入 Planity 線上預約，大型染燙可能要求線上留卡擔保。
usually_asked: Exact prestation (coupe brushing, balayage, dépose + pose vernis semi-permanent, massage)

may_come_up.what: Directs caller to Planity to complete deposit/card guarantee

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card number over phone
Demands immediate phone payment for acompte

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車廠（Garage）與驗車中心（Contrôle technique）習慣電話預約，報車牌（immatriculation）最快。
usually_asked: Vehicle registration plate (plaque d'immatriculation) and make/model, or device model
Service (révision, contrôle technique, panne) or repair symptom

may_come_up.what: Garage asks French license plate (AB-123-CD) to identify exact parts
Paid diagnostic estimate (devis payant si non réparé)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks phone unlock code over call
Demands card payment over phone to order parts

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 獨立披薩店、壽司、中餐與熟食店（Traiteur）常接電話訂自取（à emporter）到店付；外送多走 Uber Eats 或 Deliveroo。
usually_asked: Exact dishes, formulas/menus, and cooking temp

may_come_up.what: Minimum card amount (minimum carte bancaire, e.g. 10–15€) on pickup
Delivery handled via Deliveroo / Uber Eats only

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card number over phone
Requires immediate remote payment (VAD) before cooking

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 大型連鎖走按鍵客服專線，獨立書店、肉鋪（boucherie）與糕點店很歡迎電話留貨。
usually_asked: Product name, size, weight, or reference

may_come_up.what: Putting item aside (mettre de côté) valid for 24–48h max

sensitive_asked.what: Holiday order (bûche/plateau fruits de mer) requires in-store deposit (arrhes/acompte)

change.before_dialing_zh: Doctolib 或 Planity 預約若當初是線上建立，許多店家會請主人在 App 上直接改退；餐廳綁卡逾時取消會扣費。

may_come_up.what: Empreinte bancaire penalty applies within 24h window
Doctolib-only office asks patient to modify via Doctolib app

sensitive_asked.what: Clinic asks date of birth to open patient file

usually_asked: Question (service continu vs coupure, August/holiday opening, dog allowed, stock)

may_come_up.what: Brasserie offers service continu all afternoon; bistro closes 14:30–19:30

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 獨立旅館與民宿（Chambre d'hôtes）電話訂房友善，但幾乎都要求信用卡號擔保或寄付款連結。
usually_asked: Arrival and departure dates (nombre de nuitées)
Adults, children, and room type (lit double vs lits jumeaux)
Surname, first name, phone, and email

may_come_up.what: Taxe de séjour (tourist tax per person/night) extra; late arrival after 20:00 needs notice
Sends secure email link for card guarantee

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card number and expiry over phone

activity.before_dialing_zh: 密室、板網球（Padel）與體驗課多要求官網線上預付，保齡球、鄉村網球場與團體包場可電話問。

may_come_up.what: Directs small bookings to website payment

sensitive_asked.what: Requests phone card payment (VAD) to lock slot

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 必須給完整地址與樓層；巴黎與大城公寓幾乎都有兩道門禁密碼（Digicode / Interphone），AI 絕不可代給密碼！
usually_asked: Issue (plombier, serrurier, entretien chaudière, clim, déménagement)
Street, number, bâtiment/escalier, floor, elevator (ascenseur), and postal code
Name on intercom buzzer (nom sur l'interphone)

may_come_up.what: Quotes call-out fee (frais de déplacement) + hourly rate TTC; warns of written devis above 150€
Artisan calls owner upon arrival instead of taking digicode in advance

sensitive_asked.what: Asks building digicode or door entry code over phone
Demands bank transfer before visit

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫（Vétérinaire）、美容（Toilettage）與寄宿（Pension）皆採預約制，寄宿必查晶片與疫苗。
usually_asked: Vet consult (also some on CaptainVet/MonVéto), toilettage, or pension
Species, breed, weight, age, and sterilization
Vaccines including kennel cough (toux du chenil) and I-CAD identification

may_come_up.what: Trimming/epilation vs standard cut pricing difference

sensitive_asked.what: Pension requires arrhes/acompte payment to confirm

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Chronopost、Colissimo、Mondial Relay 等全國物流皆為語音機器人或付費按鍵選單，僅獨立門市與車廠可直撥查進度。
usually_asked: Tracking or repair order number (numéro de suivi / bon de dépôt)
Readiness at shop or point relais

may_come_up.what: National carrier uses automated voice/keypad bot

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Chronopost secure delivery PIN code or digicode

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信（Orange/Free/SFR）、EDF電力、銀行、保險與法航客服皆有按鍵選單且受 RGPD（GDPR）限制須本人核身。
usually_asked: Verification that caller is contract holder (titulaire)
Date of birth, address, and client reference

may_come_up.what: RGPD blocks assistant from accessing personal contract

sensitive_asked.what: Asks date of birth, RIB/IBAN, card digits, or secret code

transport.before_dialing_zh: 地方計程車（Taxi conventionné / Radio Taxi）、摩納哥叫車與地方租車門市可電話預訂（G7 等大車隊有語音選單）。

may_come_up.what: Approach fee (approche) starts on meter before pickup for pre-booked taxis
Large taxi network (e.g. G7) uses keypad IVR unless subscriber

sensitive_asked.what: Medical taxi asks Sécurité sociale number or prescription details

property.before_dialing_zh: 法國租屋競爭極烈，房仲（Agence immobilière）電話約看房時必先審核租客檔案（Dossier：CDI合約與月薪須達房租3倍）。
usually_asked: Employment status (CDI hors période d'essai), net monthly income (3x loyer), and Visale/garant

may_come_up.what: Agency requires uploading full dossier online before granting a viewing

sensitive_asked.what: Asks tax notice details or money before viewing (illegal in France)

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 市政廳（Mairie）、縣政府（Préfecture）與稅務總機有按鍵選單且個資限本人；托嬰機構（Crèche privée）可電話問名額。
usually_asked: General administrative procedure (état civil, urbanisme) or private crèche inquiry
Child birth month and days per week needed for crèche

may_come_up.what: Municipal crèche allocation handled centrally via mairie portal
Mairie switchboard uses keypad routing

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CAF allocataire number, Sécurité sociale number, or birth date
